title: PIZZA INVADERS
oneLiner: Defend the galaxy from a delicious falling pizza invasion!
mechanics: Move the chef ship left and right along the bottom.
Press A to launch tomato-sauce lasers at descending pizza aliens.
Destroy pizzas before they reach the crust line; each hit scores points.
Alien waves move sideways, speed up, and fire toppings as time passes.
lose: You lose when a pizza reaches the crust line or hits your ship.
scoring: Earn points for every pizza alien destroyed, with bonus points for clearing a wave.
